data.title: Jumeirah Living Marina Gate
data.about:
Dreaming of a lifestyle you don’t want to have a break from? Jumeirah Living Marina Gate will satisfy your fantasies for supreme luxury. The fusion of Jumeirah Group’s lavish hospitality experience and Select Group’s dedication to creating a superb modern standard of living enables Marina residents to have access to Jumeirah’s perfect benchmark for a curated lifestyle. What’s more, indulge in iconic attractions in one of the region’s most enthralling locations and welcome an array of exclusive opportunities.

The Land of Endless Opportunities
A myriad of attractions, scenic spots, and breathtaking skyline have paved the way for Dubai to make a name for itself. It is expecting to welcome 20 million people from the different parts of the world for the much-anticipated Expo 2020, which is set to expand the boundaries of creativity in efforts to develop an unprecedented environment where everyone can work, live, and play.

Offering a mix of historical and contemporary charms, stunning architectural beauty, and exquisite natural wonders all rolled into one, the city is home to more than 200 nationalities and boasts an ambitious future.

An Upscale Neighbourhood Awaits You
Jumeirah Living Marina Gate embodies the third and ultimate tower of the sophisticated Marina Gate community ideally located at the entrance to Dubai Marina, the perfect destination for people who chase the best things that life has to offer in a grandiose waterfront setting.
